identity: A very short Arabic folk tale, al-Tayr al-Akhdar (The Green Bird) - the Juniper Tree type. Title line, then two narrative paragraphs; the boy transformed into a bird sings a rhymed chant in the middle of the first paragraph (ana al-tayr al-akhdar fi qubbat al-askar ... khalf al-zir al-yamani).
law: FOLK NARRATIVE (0l) with an embedded chant. The unit is the narrative BEAT - one happening with the bare verbs that carry it - and the beats here are short because the telling is bare: 92 real tokens over 12 units = 7.7 tokens per unit, matching the 8.5 measured for the Jeddah folk tale in 0o. Batch 12s coordinator rule (1j: w/f + a new finite verb CUTS) is bounded here by 0l: a run of complement-less verbs sharing one agent and one happening (samia... wa-arafa... fa-darabaha... wa-nada... wa-baka) is ONE beat, exactly as in fa-darabuhu darbatan ala rasihi wa-qalu hadhihi dhubaba.
reasoning: Four boundaries are asyndetic and therefore uncontested: @11 (the household is set up, then the stepmothers hatred starts), @25 (her lie ends, the sister takes over as agent), @37 (the hiding ends, the transformation starts), and @20 where thumma opens the next beat. @46 wa-qala is the announcer cut (H1 in narrative, and 0l MISSED @35 where a bare wa-qala lahu was its own unit); E3 keeps a SHORT quote glued to its verb, but this quotation is a 24-token chant, which is the 0k situation (wa-qulu ends its verse) rather than the E3 one. Inside the chant I cut only at the two asyndetic joints: @52 after the rhyming self-identification couplet (akhdar / askar) and @61 after the three-clause rhyme on -ni. The three internal wa-clauses zawjatu abi habasatni / wa-ukhti khallasatni / wa-abi ma yadri anni are a rhyming tricolon over one frame - B9 isocolon - and merge; 1j does not reach them because they are 2-3 tokens each and the rhyme is the unit. Second paragraph: @83 because fa-ada al-tayr al-akhdar waladan asmar has a NEW SUBJECT (the bird) and is the resolution, not a consequence of the weeping; @88 because wa-ashu is the closing happily-ever-after formula with a third subject. I did NOT cut at @73/@77/@79/@82 - a literal reading of 1j would put six boundaries in this 22-token paragraph and give 3.7 tokens per unit, far below anything gold has ever produced.
